description: Future value of a starting sum, regular contributions, or both, grown at a fixed rate: what savings or an investment reach after a number of years. annualRate is a fraction (0.07 = 7%) split into periodsPerYear equal periods the nominal way (rate per period = annualRate / periodsPerYear); years x periodsPerYear is the number of periods, which must be whole when a payment is given. Contributions are level and made at the end of each period, or at the start with paymentTiming "begin". A fixed assumed rate, not a forecast and not a market-return simulation (for a range of outcomes use workflow.run_monte_carlo). Use when user asks "what will $10,000 plus $500 a month be worth in 30 years at 7%?" or "how much will I have after 10 years of saving?". Returns: futureValue, fvOfPresentValue, fvOfPayments, growthFactor, ratePerPeriod, periods, totalContributions, interestEarned, effectiveAnnualRate.

annualRate.description: Annual growth rate as a fraction (0.07 = 7%); may be zero or negative, but the rate per period must stay above -100%

periodsPerYear.description: Compounding and contribution periods per year, 1 to 365. Default 1 (12 = monthly)

presentValue.description: Starting amount, in any currency. Default 0

years.description: Length in years, 0 to 1000 (fractions allowed for a lump sum; with payments years x periodsPerYear must be a whole number)

name: workflow.run_future_value
